prompt: Elegant physical ivory shield beside a realistic sage stethoscope and closed reference book. A soft controlled studio light moves subtly across the shield and camera pushes in a few centimeters. No certification seal, name, logo, award or guaranteed outcome.
full_prompt:
Generate a 10-second silent vertical 9:16 video, 1080×1920, 30fps, photoreal/editorial or refined realistic 3D as specified. Stable geometry and consistent lighting, soft ivory background, muted sage/teal accents, restrained champagne highlights. Keep the lower 20% visually quiet for later captions. Use purposeful continuous motion, not random shaking or a static image hold. No text, captions, watermark, logo, recognizable app/brand, treatment promises, skin-whitening, before/after, patient outcome or copied face. No soundtrack; original doctor narration will continue over this insert.
